findings.passage: You may need to show identification when you check-in at your polling place if:
findings.note: Voter information page on her campaign site. It lists four cases when ID may be asked at check-in: first-time voting in Massachusetts, being on the inactive voter list, casting a provisional or challenged ballot, or a poll worker having a practical and legal reason to ask. The page is undated; the year is an estimate from the 2026 election content (registration deadline October 26th).
